newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q2 HOUSING PRICES +3 PCT Q/Q,+19 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q2 HOUSING PRICES +3 PCT Q/Q,+19 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Prices of old apartments rose three percent in the second quarter compared to the first and prices rose 19 percent year-on-year, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
The nation-wide average price per square metre was 6,479 markka in Q2 against 6,291 markka in Q1, SF said.
In Helsinki and nearby areas, the average square metre price was 9,001 markka against 8,809 markka, it said.

SF said real term apartment prices were now back at the same level as in the mid-1980s. Apartment prices rose steeply in the late 1980s, but collapsed with the onset of the deep recession in the early 1990s.
